reason: A is the better proposal because Si addition plausibly couples lower-temperature liquid-assisted densification with formation of a protective silica/borosilicate scale, whereas SPS in B can reduce porosity but does not fundamentally remedy ZrB2 oxidation or liquid-metal attack. A still needs direct evidence that a few atomic percent Si can densify ZrB2 below 1700 °C and protect it in the specified plating bath, plus explicit high-temperature and prior-material controls.
